messages:
morgan: quick sync — spotted several label mismatches between the console help panel and docs site. e.g. console uses “Prompt templates” but docs use “Prompt library”. also the help icon's aria-label reads "Help" vs "Open docs".
kelly (design): ugh, agreed. that mismatch confuses new users during onboarding flows. can we pick one canonical term?
jisoo: +1. from analytics, searches for "prompt templates" are 3x higher than "prompt library". leaning toward Templates.
samir: i think Templates is clearer. also noticed routing dropdown says "Model routes" while docs call it "Model variants" — different mental models.
iain: can we map the names to product concepts? Templates -> user-facing reusable prompts; Variants -> infra model splits. that separation would help.
morgan: proposal: use "Prompt templates" everywhere in UI/docs, and use "Model variants" in infra pages. when vocabulary overlaps, add a sentence in docs defining both.
kelly (design): noted. UI copy change: Help panel header should be "Docs & help" not "Help" — easier for screen readers. add aria-label "Open docs panel" pls.
jisoo: can someone add cross-links in the console panel at top linking to both the Templates doc and Model variants doc? currently only links to the quickstart.
samir: i can wire the two links — would like short anchor text: "Docs: Prompt templates" and "Docs: Model variants".
docs-bot: FYI — I pushed a PR updating the docs-to-console crosslink mappings, branch: docs/console-linking-148.
morgan: nice. can we also add search aliases so console search finds "prompt library" -> "prompt templates"? engineers will need a mapping file.
iain: adding to infra backlog. @samir can you own the mapping config? ETA end of week?
samir: yes i'll own it. will add a small JSON map and a note in README.
kelly (design): accessibility check: change icon button aria-label to "Open docs and help" and ensure contrast ratio for the panel header meets AA.
jisoo: quick QA note — when panel opens from the API settings page, the internal anchor for "templates" doesn't scroll correctly. probable different slug in docs.
morgan: action items: samir -> implement crosslinks + alias mapping (due Fri), kelly -> update header copy and aria labels (due Thu), jisoo -> verify anchor slugs in docs and open PR if mismatch (due Wed). I'll follow up in this thread.
kelly (design): +1. I'll attach revised copy snippets in a sec.
jisoo: thanks. small nit: in docs sidebar the breadcrumb says "Docs / Features / Templates" vs console breadcrumb "Help > Prompt templates" — maybe harmonize to "Docs / Prompt templates".
morgan: good catch. ok let's converge on the shorter label "Prompt templates" across menus and breadcrumbs. keep infra docs as "Model variants" where appropriate.
samir: will post the config diff here once ready.
docs-bot: deploy hook: docs staging build scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC.
morgan: perfect. thanks team :thumbsup:
